lines.text: Did you know? Log is Greek for word or study.
Logic: the study of right reason.
Technology: skill plus word or study.
Quick quiz! Which means skill plus word or study?
Technology! Skill plus word or study.

words.ex: I don't understand the logic of this decision.
New technology makes it easier to learn online.
